The claim states that Sabella's Density Emitter models particle density as a continuous function rather than discrete entities, allowing for varying light intensity along a ray. Furthermore, the text notes that 'The intensity of the light reaching the eye, in Sabella's method, allows varying densities', which supports the part of the claim regarding varying light intensity.
